summary: 용사 36명: 특급 24명(속성 4 × 무기 6의 모든 조합에 한 명씩), 일반 12명(무기마다 2명, 속성마다 3명). element: water 물 · fire 불 · earth 땅 · wind 바람. weapon: src/sim/core/types.ts의 WEAPON_TYPES (oneHandSword 한손검 · greatsword 대검 · dagger 단검 · bow 활 · crossbow 석궁 · staff 지팡이). role: 근접 / 원거리 / 힐러. look은 Codex 프롬프트의 영웅 문단에 그대로 넣을 영어 묘사(STYLE + 참조 안내 + 공통 문단 뒤). existing_art가 있으면 이미 그린 예제다.
palette_hint: 속성 색 기운: water = 파랑·남색·하늘색, fire = 녹슨 빨강·주황·벽돌색, earth = 황토·올리브·카키·갈색, wind = 잎 초록·민트 (네아만 예전 그림대로 청록).

heroes.name: 바일
heroes.look: A sturdy young man with broad square shoulders, short dark-brown tufty hair and a blunt, serious flat mouth, in a rust-red tunic (#b5523b) with a brown belt and brown trousers. He holds a plain one-handed sword pointing down at his side; a small worn ledger is tucked into the front of his tunic and a pale pink burn mark sits on the back of his right hand.

heroes.name: 시엔
heroes.line: 검을 쓴 날보다 닦은 날이 많다.
heroes.look: A neat, slim young woman (about 20) with a high black ponytail and a calm, tidy face with a small satisfied smile, in a clean sea-blue tunic with a white collar and grey trousers. She holds a plain one-handed sword in one hand and a small white cloth in the other as if polishing it, and a tiny wooden bucket with a scrub brush hangs from her belt.

heroes.name: 도윈
heroes.line: 힘은 장사인데, 말을 걸면 귀가 빨개진다.
heroes.look: A very tall, lanky, shy young man with long arms and big mitten hands, a short olive-brown mop of hair, eyes glancing away and pink blushing cheeks and ears, in an ochre-brown tunic and khaki trousers. He holds a plain one-handed sword awkwardly close to his chest, and one small white daisy is tucked behind his ear.

heroes.name: 키오
heroes.look: A cheerful scrawny boy of about 14 with spiky light-brown hair and a wide open grin, in a leaf-green short tunic and rolled-up brown trousers. He raises a plain one-handed sword high, and a small four-blade paper pinwheel (plain mint and cream blades) sticks up from his headband.

heroes.name: 오델
heroes.look: A very big, broad, gentle man, the roundest of all the heroes, with short buzzed hair, small calm sleepy dot eyes and a slight nodding tilt of the head, in earthy khaki-brown clothes (#7a6a4f) with a leather strap across his chest. He rests a big plain greatsword on his shoulder, and an oversized backpack on his back has one extra bundle tied on top (someone else's luggage).

heroes.name: 베르다
heroes.line: 은퇴는 내일 한다. 매일 그렇게 말한다.
heroes.look: A short, stocky old grandmother warrior, still strong, with grey hair in a round bun, kind smiling crescent eyes, a warm small smile and one short scar line across her cheek, in a dull steel breastplate over a faded maroon tunic and a short faded cape. She leans with both hands on her sheathed greatsword planted point-down in front of her, like an old lady leaning on a cane.

heroes.name: 로나
heroes.look: A tall, broad-shouldered woman in her forties, a former ferry rower, with a navy-blue knit cap over short sandy hair and a relaxed lopsided half-smile, in a navy-blue sleeveless vest over a cream shirt with the sleeves rolled up. She carries a big plain greatsword over her shoulder the way a rower carries an oar, with a coil of rope looped over her other shoulder.

heroes.name: 다로
heroes.look: A tiny boy of about 8, the smallest hero of all, with round cheeks, a determined pouting mouth and a mint-green headband over messy black hair, in a leaf-green tunic and little boots. He grips a plain greatsword that is much TALLER than he is with both hands, its tip resting on the ground behind him as he drags it along.

heroes.name: 아렌
heroes.look: A skinny, wiry young man, light and carefree, with messy light-brown tufty hair and lips puckered in a small whistle, in an amber-ochre short jacket (#a8743a), cream shirt and dark brown trousers, one hand on his hip. He spins one dagger in his raised hand while a second dagger stays sheathed at his hip, its handle wrapped in a faded cloth strip (his older brother's, never used).

heroes.name: 세온
heroes.line: 머리 위 개구리와 말이 잘 통한다.
heroes.look: A slim, easygoing young man with wavy blue-black hair and sleepy, contented half-closed eyes, in a short sky-blue hooded rain cape over a grey tunic. He holds a small plain dagger loosely in one hand, and a small round green frog sits calmly on top of his head.

heroes.name: 헤른
heroes.look: A short, slightly hunched old grandpa gardener with a neat little white moustache (no beard) and kind crinkled eyes, in a khaki-olive gardener's apron over a brown shirt. He holds a small curved dagger like a pruning knife, and a little green sprout grows out of the top of his floppy brown sun cap.

heroes.name: 피아
heroes.look: A quick, skinny courier girl of about 14 with two short dark-brown pigtails and a busy, determined face, standing on her toes and leaning forward as if about to dash off, in a mint-green short jacket and brown shorts. She holds a small plain dagger in one hand, and a big brown satchel stuffed with plain blank envelopes (no writing) hangs at her hip.

heroes.name: 네아
heroes.look: A slim young woman archer with narrow line eyes and dark teal-brown hair blown to one side, her mouth open mid-sentence while one finger points ahead, in a short teal-blue hooded cloak (#4f8a9e) over a cream shirt with a small quiver on her back. She holds a simple wooden longbow with a single white feather tied to its top tip.

heroes.name: 누아
heroes.look: A small girl of about 10 in a big pale-blue raincoat with the hood down, with a short black bob, big watery eyes with one single tear drop on her cheek and a wobbly but brave mouth. She holds a simple wooden bow with an arrow nocked, aimed perfectly straight and steady, in funny contrast to her teary face.

heroes.name: 보로
heroes.look: A round, chubby young man with closed happy eyes and a big cheerful grin, a red bandana over short ginger hair, in an orange-red tunic and brown trousers. He holds a simple wooden shortbow in one hand and a single arrow in the other with a whole roasted sweet potato skewered on its tip, one tiny curl of steam rising from it.

heroes.name: 엘다
heroes.line: 머리에 새가 둥지를 틀었다. 그냥 둔다.
heroes.look: A tall, slender, quiet woman ranger in her thirties with one long dark-brown braid, calm half-closed eyes and a straight mouth, in a moss-olive hooded cloak and brown leggings, holding a tall plain longbow upright beside her. A small round bird's nest with one little brown bird in it sits on top of her head, and she does not mind it at all.

heroes.name: 토마
heroes.look: A stocky, calm middle-aged man with half-closed sleepy eyes (one shut as if quietly aiming), a short stalk of grass in the corner of his mouth and a flat stubble patch on his chin, in a wide-brimmed soft hat, olive and mud-brown clothes and a sturdy brown vest. He holds a big heavy wooden crossbow low at his hip with both hands, perfectly still and unbothered.

heroes.name: 이솔
heroes.line: 지붕 위로 다닌다. 계단은 잘 모른다.
heroes.look: A small, light, quiet girl of about 12 with short grey-black hair, standing on tiptoe on one foot with her arms out for balance and looking up with a curious face, in a simple grey-brown tunic. A long grey scarf (#8a8a8f) smudged with a few darker ash spots flutters around her neck, and a small crossbow is slung on her back with its limbs sticking out behind her shoulders.

heroes.name: 리브
heroes.look: A small, bookish young woman tinkerer with huge round glasses, a messy auburn bun with a pencil stuck in it and a proud grin, in blue work overalls over a cream shirt with a brown tool belt. She hugs a home-made crossbow with a few extra gears, a lever and a little crank bolted on, still drawn as a few simple flat shapes.

heroes.name: 밀로
heroes.look: A stocky, jolly middle-aged miller with a big bushy brown moustache (no beard), rosy cheeks and a dab of white flour on his nose, in a pale-green work shirt with rolled sleeves and a white apron dusted with flour. He holds a sturdy wooden crossbow at his side, and a small white flour sack is slung over his back.

heroes.name: 유나
heroes.look: A small, cheerful young woman mage with short dark hair peeking out of a soft blue hooded robe and a proud smile with closed happy eyes. Lots of tiny round pouches hang from her belt, shoulder strap and staff, each with a little red, blue, green or yellow crystal peeking out, and she holds a simple wooden staff topped with one blue crystal.

heroes.name: 하엘
heroes.look: A tall, slim, composed woman mage, a little taller than the other chibi heroes (about 3 heads, never more), with a short chestnut-brown bob, round human ears and a calm expressionless face, in a plain cream robe and a long deep-forest-green cape billowing far out to one side. She holds a tall plain wooden staff, taller than her, topped with one flat round amber stone.

heroes.name: 카렐
heroes.look: A lanky young man mage with a big puffy frizzy hairdo whose tips are singed black, a single small puff of grey smoke above it, and a startled-but-proud face (round dot eyes, small round mouth), in a rust-red robe with slightly scorched sleeve ends. He holds a crooked wooden staff topped with a small flat orange flame shape.

heroes.name: 모라
heroes.look: A plump, kind middle-aged herbalist woman with round rosy cheeks and a warm closed-eye smile, brown hair tied up in an olive kerchief, in an ochre-brown dress with a big olive apron. She leans on a short gnarled wooden staff with two green leaves sprouting from its top and carries a small woven basket of green herbs on her arm.

heroes.name: 신참 검사 비코
heroes.look: A nervous, thin teenage boy whose way-too-big dented iron helmet slides down over his eyes so only his small wobbly worried mouth shows, with three big sweat drops flying off his head, in a cheap padded cream vest and patched brown trousers, knock-kneed. He grips a rusty, chipped one-handed sword stiffly in front of him with both hands.

heroes.name: 양치기 리타
heroes.look: A plain teenage shepherd girl with a short brown bob and sleepy half-closed eyes in the middle of a yawn, in a simple mint-green tunic with a cream wool shawl. She holds a plain one-handed sword in one hand and a short wooden shepherd's crook in the other.

heroes.name: 빨래꾼 브리
heroes.look: A plump middle-aged washerwoman with a blue headscarf, sleeves rolled up and a cheerful no-nonsense face, in a plain blue dress with a white apron. She carries a plain greatsword over her shoulder the same easy way she would carry a laundry paddle.

heroes.name: 빵집 아들 페노
heroes.look: A broad, cheerful young man with a short orange-brown crew cut and a smudge of flour on one cheek, in a plain brick-red shirt and a white baker's apron. He holds a plain greatsword out in front of him with both hands like a big bread peel.

heroes.name: 정찰병 슈
heroes.line: 숨바꼭질에서 진 적이 없다. 다들 먼저 집에 가서.
heroes.look: A small, quiet girl of about 13 in an oversized pale-green hood that hides most of her hair, with shy dot eyes peeking out, in a simple green-grey tunic. She holds a small plain dagger close to her chest.

heroes.name: 버섯꾼 포리
heroes.look: A small round-faced boy of about 10 with a bowl haircut and a curious open mouth, in a plain ochre-brown tunic. He holds a small plain dagger and carries a little basket with a few brown mushrooms on his arm.

heroes.name: 견습 궁수 토리
heroes.look: A plain girl archer of about 15 with a short orange-red ponytail and a determined squint, in a simple rust-orange tunic and brown trousers. She holds a small plain shortbow, and a red apple with an arrow stuck through it hangs from her belt.

heroes.name: 어부 오토
heroes.look: A thin, slightly stooped old fisherman with grey stubble (no beard), a floppy navy-blue hat and calm patient eyes, in a faded blue shirt and rolled-up trousers. He holds a simple wooden bow, and a small empty fishing basket hangs at his hip.

heroes.name: 문지기 테사
heroes.line: 문은 잘 지킨다. 열쇠는 자주 잃는다.
heroes.look: A sturdy, round young woman town gatekeeper with a plain round iron helmet and a broad friendly grin, in a simple blue padded tunic. She holds a plain crossbow at her side, and one big iron key dangles from her belt on a string.

heroes.name: 광부 호브
heroes.look: A short, stocky middle-aged miner with dirt smudges on his cheeks and a plain brown mining helmet with a small lamp on its front, in a khaki work shirt and brown trousers. He holds a sturdy plain crossbow in both hands.

heroes.name: 견습 마법사 노노
heroes.line: 불은 켤 줄 안다. 끄는 건 배우는 중.
heroes.look: A small apprentice mage boy of about 11 with a nervous but proud smile, in a rust-red robe far too long for him (the hem pools around his boots) and a floppy pointed hat. He holds a short wooden staff with a tiny flat orange flame on top.

heroes.name: 견습 치유사 솜
heroes.line: 붕대는 잘 감는다. 너무 잘 감는다.
heroes.look: A gentle teenage apprentice healer girl with short light-brown hair and a soft smile, in a white dress with a short mint-green cape. She holds a simple wooden staff with one small green leaf on top, and a roll of white bandage hangs from her belt with one end trailing down.
